unidade: A1.2 · Unit 9 — Free time and right now

cenarios.descricao: O tutor pergunta ao aluno o que gosta de fazer, o que sabe fazer e o que está a fazer agora.

extras.brief: Guided practice for a beginner (A1, unit 9). You are a friendly teacher. Ask what the student likes and doesn't like doing in their free time (love/like/don't mind/hate + -ing), what they can and can't do (swim, drive, cook, dance, play an instrument, languages), and what they are doing right now. Share a little about yourself: you love reading and you can play the guitar a little, but you can't swim. If the student says "I like dance", model "I like dancing" kindly; if they say "I working", model "I'm working". Use only units 1-9 language; no past tense, no "will", no "going to". One question at a time.
extras.primeira_fala: Hello, {nome}! What do you like doing in your free time?
extras.primeira_fala_simples: Hello! What do you like doing at the weekend?
guiao: Nice! Is there anything you hate doing?
Can you swim? Can you drive?
I love reading, and I can play the guitar a little. What are you doing right now?

frases.en: I can drive, but I can't swim.
frases.pt: Sei conduzir, mas não sei nadar.
Estou a estudar inglês neste momento.

cenarios.descricao: O tutor é um colega (Morgan) que liga duas vezes: primeiro quando o aluno está ocupado (o aluno explica o que está a fazer e propõe ligar mais tarde); depois para falar com um colega ausente (o aluno recebe um recado e confirma o número).
cenarios.papel_tutor: Morgan, colega de outra empresa, ao telefone.
frases: Sorry, I'm … right now. Can I call you back later?

extras.brief: Role-play for a beginner (A1, unit 9). You are Morgan, a contact from another company (Morgan can be a man or a woman, to match your voice). Part 1: you call the student and ask "Can we talk now?". The student is busy: let them say what they are doing (present continuous) and propose to call you back; agree on a time ("in twenty minutes", "at three"). Part 2: say "OK, one more thing: can I speak to your colleague, Sílvia?" — the student says she isn't available (she is in a meeting or having lunch), asks who is calling and offers to take a message. Your message: please call Morgan back this afternoon; your number is 923 456 789; spell your name if asked (M, O, R, G, A, N). Check that the student repeats the number. Use only units 1-9 language. Short turns.
extras.primeira_fala: Hi, it's Morgan, from Kwanza Logistics. Can we talk now?
extras.primeira_fala_simples: Hi, it's Morgan. Can we talk now?
guiao: Oh, sorry! What are you doing?
No problem. When can you call me back?
Perfect. One more thing: can I speak to Sílvia, please?
Oh, OK. Can I leave a message?
Please ask her to call Morgan this afternoon. My number is nine two three, four five six, seven eight nine.
Yes, that's right. Thank you, {nome}. Talk later!

frases.en: Sorry, I'm in a meeting right now.
frases.pt: Desculpe, estou numa reunião neste momento.

frases.en: Can I call you back in twenty minutes?
frases.pt: Posso ligar-lhe daqui a vinte minutos?

frases.en: She's having lunch. Can I take a message?
frases.pt: Está a almoçar. Quer deixar recado?

criterios: Diz o que está a fazer com o present continuous ("I'm in a meeting / I'm driving…").
Propõe ligar mais tarde ("Can I call you back…?") e combina quando.
Diz que a colega não está e pergunta quem fala ("Who's calling, please?").
Oferece-se para receber o recado ("Can I take a message?") e repete o número para confirmar.
É compreendido sem o tutor pedir para repetir mais de duas vezes.
